rules: Every runtime env read by cmd/riido_ai_server must appear exactly once in this manifest.
Generated docs must not contain live values, account ids, raw tokens, or deployment evidence.
Secret or credential env vars may document names and semantics only, never values.
Profile thumbnail configuration signs upload intents; image bytes are never proxied by control-plane.
Tracing metadata must use route patterns and operation names only, not task ids, prompts, credentials, or raw content.
Public PR checks must not require AWS credentials or Terraform state.

loop.observation: The config reference was manual prose and missed at least one runtime env constant.
loop.hypothesis: Scanning cmd/riido_ai_server env reads against a manifest can prevent config drift without live infrastructure.
loop.execute: Generate this reader from the manifest and verify the runtime env surface in CI.
loop.evaluate: The verifier checks source env parity, sensitive-name classification, generated doc freshness, and evidence output.
loop.retrospective: This makes the public config catalog executable; private deployment values remain outside this repository.

non_config_facts: AWS account IDs, subnet IDs, security groups, domains, ACM certificates, Route53 zones, WAF IDs, ECR repositories, ECS task definitions
Terraform backend settings, state files, tfvars, plans, or apply logs
raw bearer tokens, review account raw token values, IdP client secrets, or AWS credentials
daemon provider executable paths or customer workspace roots
